reasoning: SafeTradie requires a robust, authoritative, and high-visibility interface to align with the construction and trades industry. A high-contrast light theme with 'warning yellow' accents and strict geometric layouts ensures maximum readability on job sites (mobile-first for incident reporting) while projecting enterprise trust (for AI document generation and compliance).

rules.hierarchy_gap: Ensure size jumps are max 2 Tailwind steps between heading and subheading.

rules.tints: Never use pure grayscale; tint neutrals slightly cool.
rules.contrast: Ensure all text meets minimum 4.5:1 APCA contrast. High contrast on active states.
rules.hover: Explicitly set hover background AND text (e.g. hover:bg-black hover:text-white). Focus rings must be high contrast.

marketing_page.grid: Tetris Grid (asymmetry, visual tension, grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8)
marketing_page.alignment: Left-align dense text; avoid center-everything disease.

dashboard_and_app.grid: Control Room Grid (density, data correlation, grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4 or gap-6)
dashboard_and_app.surfaces: Cardless or sharp flat borders with max 4px radius (rounded-sm). No glassmorphism in app.

marketing.strategy: Pure HTML + Tailwind for structural layouts. Use raw divs/sections for overlapping bento grids.
marketing.hero: Real tradie imagery with maximum bg-black/40 overlay or gradient. Never go darker if it obscures the image.
marketing.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee. Editorial Ribbon style (slow, low contrast, wide gaps).

dashboard.strategy: Shadcn components heavily customized to match the Swiss Brutalist aesthetic.
dashboard.forms: Shadcn Input, Select, Form. Do not use native HTML form elements.
dashboard.buttons: Sharp edges (rounded-none or rounded-sm). Primary action gets Warning Yellow or Deep Black background.
dashboard.cards: Flat background (bg-white or bg-slate-50), 1px solid border-border, no shadow by default. Hover adds subtle shadow and translates -translate-y-1.

motion_and_interactions.hover: Interactive elements must have clear hover state (color change or translate).
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use specific properties (transition-transform, transition-colors duration-200 ease-out).

icons_and_assets.style: Duotone or bold weight depending on context (Phosphor is ideal for field service dashboard clarity).

testing.requirement: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='submit-incident-button').

hero_marketing.description: Wide-angle photograph of a rugged Australian construction site at golden hour, featuring a worker in high-vis gear.

abstract_compliance.description: Abstract geometric composition with warning yellow, sharp black lines.

worker_context_1.description: A person wearing a hard hat, useful for testimonials or worker profiles.

worker_context_2.description: A man wearing a hard hat working on a machine, good for feature sections (e.g., Incident Reporting).

worker_context_3.description: Female engineer in hard hat using a tablet, good for 'People & Licence Management' feature.

logo_partner_3.description: Retro Apple logo for partner marquee.

instructions_to_main_agent.1: Install the required font families: Cabinet Grotesk (from Fontshare or local assets) and IBM Plex Sans (from Google Fonts). Update tailwind.config.js to include these.
instructions_to_main_agent.3: Install `react-fast-marquee` for the partner logos section in the marketing page.
instructions_to_main_agent.4: Ensure the application heavily utilizes data-testid attributes across all clickable or input-driven UI components.
instructions_to_main_agent.5: Do not default to standard rounded 'Vercel' components. Override Shadcn configurations in globals.css/tailwind.config to enforce sharp or minimal-radius borders.
instructions_to_main_agent.6: Ensure the dashboard uses a strictly grid-based 'Control Room' layout where data is dense but highly legible due to stark color contrasts.
instructions_to_main_agent.7: Do not use placeholders for images. Use the provided URLs strictly.
